solution:
One solution:
SELECT e.FirstName,e.Surname,r.Grade FROM Employee e JOIN Role r ON e.RoleID=r.RoleID WHERE e.Surname='Chen' AND r.Grade=8;

marking_points.criterion: Both surname and grade filters with AND.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: SQLite join/filter executed on matching and nonmatching rows.
verification.test_code:
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');c.executescript("CREATE TABLE Employee(EmployeeID,FirstName,Surname,RoleID);CREATE TABLE Role(RoleID,Grade);INSERT INTO Role VALUES(1,8),(2,7);INSERT INTO Employee VALUES(1,'A','Chen',1),(2,'B','Chen',2),(3,'C','Mora',1);")
assert c.execute("SELECT e.FirstName,e.Surname,r.Grade FROM Employee e JOIN Role r ON e.RoleID=r.RoleID WHERE e.Surname='Chen' AND r.Grade=8").fetchall()==[('A','Chen',8)]
